scope: Outline layout, branch animation, scrolling, and collection drag/drop performance

environment.devices: Desktop hardware only; narrow layouts are viewport emulation, not CPU throttling
environment.tree: 100 folders with children; 10,000 records includes 100 folders and 9,900 children

method.profiler: Roblox rbx-perf-profiling skill; LibMP CaptureToBufferSync and Session.OpenFromBuffer; CPU frame-local scope accounting with session/iterator disposal
method.drag: 120 updates per gesture using production drag callbacks, native engine hit testing, rendering, animation, autoscroll and actual model reorders
method.timing: Callback wall time measured separately with os.clock. Most captures summarize final 120 frames; full-capture analysis includes pickup. The final bitmap table capture also includes drop and subsequent frames.
limitations: Synthetic text cells are not equivalent to production images and rich editors.
CUA native drags emitted DragStart/DragEnd but no DragContinue. Native gesture performance was not validated by that attempt.
No real low-end mobile or gamepad performance capture.
MicroProfiler scope costs are inclusive and must not be summed into frame critical-path time.
Earlier result drops counters are cumulative per mounted case; rejected outline adds no model mutation.

The 75.083 ms bitmap-table frame also contains a synchronous MicroProfiler snapshot. It is not an isolated application hitch measurement; the 17.630 ms drop callback and 15.133 ms model-reorder scope are measured separately from snapshot capture.

fixes: Cache measured collection sizes until measurements change.
Use logical list focus positions instead of rebuilding all pixel positions on layout changes.
Progressively reveal outline branches so tiny animated rows do not mount the entire branch.
Construct disclosure controls only for branches.
Cache drag item order and search Compose measured placements instead of scanning every item each update.
Cache sibling insertion lookup; invalidate on tree/order/selection changes and validate current items at drop.
nativeAPIs: ScrollingFrame native viewport/scroll and UIListLayout measurement
Compose OrderedCollection windowing and placementOf; Compose formulas, tweens and conditional mounting
assessment: Large steady drags and outline expansion improved substantially. Low-end readiness remains unproven: bitmap table scrolling and ~18 ms drop callback work need further optimization and physical low-end capture.

validation.full: Behavior suite, strict types, bench and package checks pass in final full run. Overall gate remains non-green: legacy rr brand/call-shape fixtures, six old capture metadata records, and host timing budget violations.
validation.builds: PASS: Lab, all 12 example places, package build and package status. Local build only; not published.

controllerEmulator.inputSetup: Lab automatic input and platform; initial focus set for each case; actions sent through visible Controller Emulator keyboard mappings
checks: Two-column hierarchy: D-pad Left collapses; Right expands, then enters first child; A selects; Left returns to parent.
Gamepad A enters Edit mode. A on Move picks up selected row; D-pad Down changes sibling insertion; A commits exactly one reorder.
City moved after Glacier; focus returned to City Move; no carried preview remained.
B cancellation changed preview position across 13 sampled animation frames, preserved model order and returned focus to the source Move handle.
Standalone Outline: Right expands Championship; Right enters Coastal Circuit; A selects it.
D-pad Down focuses Time trials; Right expands it and enters Harbour; A selects Harbour; Left returns to Time trials; Left collapses it. Hidden Harbour selection is preserved.
Pixel Quest focus/selection and square rows inspected; Parchment pickup and insertion previews inspected.
limitations: Controller emulator, not physical controller hardware.
Controller interaction evidence does not establish low-end device performance.
